overview: Based on the published agenda, the City of Mosinee Common Council was scheduled to hold its third budget workshop on November 2, 2026, to review proposed revenues and expenditures for the 2027 fiscal year and take action on a preliminary budget. The meeting was also set to address building permit applications and receive public input on the budget proposals.

agenda.item: Call to Order and Pledge of Allegiance
Public Meeting Participation Notice - Video/Teleconference Participation Notice
Discussion and possible action: Building Permit Applications
2027 Budget Workshop #3 - Discussion: 2027 Budget - Proposed Revenues and Expenditures
Discussion and possible action: City of Mosinee Preliminary 2027 Budget

discussions.body: The Common Council was scheduled to discuss and take possible action on building permit applications. The agenda indicated this item was set for consideration, though specific applications were not detailed in the published agenda.

As part of the third budget workshop, the council was set to discuss the city's proposed revenues and expenditures for the 2027 fiscal year. This workshop was scheduled to review financial projections and departmental budgets before final adoption.

The council was scheduled to discuss and take possible action on the preliminary 2027 budget for the City of Mosinee. This item was set to follow the revenue and expenditure discussion and potentially move toward formal budget adoption.

publicComment: Public Input was indicated on the agenda as a separate item.
